Frontend.reason: Tracker keeps learning content local by default and lets a signed-in learner choose cloud storage for a new or edited plan, including each AI-confirmed plan, practice record, timer record, or word record. The plan editor and AI confirmation show the plan allowance before a paired transfer. Cloud failures, offline retry and switching back to local keep the local content intact and state the real pending outcome instead of claiming a completed upload or deletion. The existing word-record sync and shared account-center work remain part of the same coordinated Tracker release.

Backend.reason: A paired Formal release adds optional per-kind Tracker cloud quotas, caller-only aggregate quota capabilities, a backward-compatible batch marker, and atomic upload/detach endpoints for a plan together with its executions. Existing cloud data is kept and grandfathered; data the learner removes and later uploads again uses the current allowance. The shared word-record validator and permanent-account-deletion endpoint remain required counterparts, with all ownership and server-secret boundaries preserved.

Admin.reason: The paired Lexi Control release adds a simple global switch, five content-type allowances, aggregate per-user use counts and sparse per-user overrides. It continues to expose only aggregate sync and account information, never individual plans, notes, execution details, or word-record payloads.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. First apply and verify the compatible Formal database migrations and protected shared-account endpoints; then deploy the matching Tracker client and Lexi Control build; finally enable optional content-cloud storage in Lexi Control. The vocabulary product and its already deployed cloud-wordbook behavior are not changed by this Tracker release.

Verification.reason: Tracker impact/typecheck/lint/test/build gates passed locally, including 66 test files and 424 tests. The Formal full release gate also passed, including the new Tracker quota migrations and Lexi Control checks. Production still needs authenticated RPC, normal second-device and cross-account smoke tests after the compatible migrations and matching Pages builds are deployed.
